x_hook1.text: [serious] Fourteen thousand premature deaths a year in Kazakhstan are linked to air pollution.

x_hook2.text: [quietly] Up to twenty-one hundred of them... in Almaty alone.

x_intro.text: The answers that could protect people are buried in a hundred and fifty sources from A-A-I. [pause] Taza Copilot finds them in seconds. Meet three people.

x_dana1.text: Dana is a journalist on deadline: did the air really get cleaner? A request like hers used to take AAI's team about five hours.

x_dana2.text: Taza answers in seconds, with the exact quote, the page and the link. She compares cities, checks a claim, and prints a policy brief.

x_aliya1.text: Aliya has two kids. She doesn't open websites. She texts Taza on WhatsApp, like a friend. In Russian, English, or Kazakh.

x_aliya2.text: And when her hands are full... she just calls.

x_tg1.text: On Telegram, Taza lives where parents already talk. A daily air card for the school.

x_tg2.text: Questions by voice. Forwarded rumours, fact-checked.

x_tg3.text: Air near me, saved places, and alerts. And inline, in any chat.

x_arman1.text: Nine p.m. Arman is driving the evening rush for inDrive. Taza tells him the air right now, the worst hours, and the cleanest.

x_arman2.text: Stuck in traffic? Shut the windows. With them open, drivers breathe air seven times dirtier than pedestrians. [pause] AAI's research, page five.

x_arman3.text: One call to Taza's partner API. For every driver and rider, in three languages.

x_admin1.text: Behind it all: the AAI team. One person, no code. Upload a report, and Taza quotes it seconds later. Subscribers get a five-point summary, in three languages.

x_admin2.text: Taza checks air.org.kz every day. An outdated source is hidden in one click. And the questions nobody could answer show what to research next.

x_proof.text: Every answer is measured: forty-four out of forty-four correct. Any AI provider works, or a local model with Ollama, where the AI cost is zero. Hosting: about seven dollars a month.

metric.text: [serious] From hours of reading reports... to a sourced answer in seconds.

thanks.text: Thank you. Try it, right now. [pause] And now... over to Aimira.

c_en_q.text: Hi Taza! Can my kids walk to school this morning?

c3_en_a.text: Yes, the morning is one of the cleanest times today. Avoid eight to ten in the evening.

c_ru_q.text: А какая школа в Алматы с самым грязным воздухом?

c3_ru_a.text: По исследованию AAI — школа номер сто пятьдесят шесть, в Алатауском районе.

c_kk_q.text: Ал 2025 жылы қай ауданда ауа ең лас болды?

c_kk_a.text: Түрксіб ауданы: орташа PM2.5 қырық алты бүтін сегіз микрограмм, Бостандықтан екі еседен астам жоғары.
